entities.summary: Ram Niwas Mirdha was an Indian statesman, parliamentarian, and cultural administrator in post-independence India. A veteran member of the Indian National Congress, Mirdha holds the record for being longest serving speaker of the Rajasthan Assembly, from 1957 to 1967. Mirdha later elected to the Rajya Sabha and served several positions including Deputy Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha, from 1977 to 1980. At the Union level, he served as Minister of State for Home Affairs and Defence, while Cabinet Minister for Communications, Textiles, Health, and Water Resources, during the 1970s and 1980s.
